entity: New York State Historic Preservation Officer
stance_basis: confirmed no effect on historic properties via official letter to UMTA
summary: The New York State Historic Preservation Officer confirmed in a May 4, 1977 letter to UMTA that the project will have no effect upon structures included in or eligible for inclusion in the National Register of Historic Places. The officer's position is presented as a factual determination rather than an expression of support or opposition to the project overall.
